reason: 评审候选 skill-cli：让任何能跑 shell 的规划者装上 skill 就能用，不必配置 MCP。relay 工具面：CLI 补全 agents、dispatch、wait、result、apply、discard、cancel，并让 status --json 输出 relay_status 的格式，全部复用 createRelay().call()；createRelay 增加 maxWaitSeconds（MCP 仍为 50 秒，CLI 上限 3600 秒）。路由手册：skills/agenthub-relay/scripts/ 放 src/ 的生成副本，SKILL.md 改为以脚本为主、MCP 可选；新增只能显式调用的 relay-review 与 relay-status。预期行为：用 CLI 走完 dispatch→wait→result→apply，结果与 MCP 路径一致；执行者角色调用 CLI dispatch 被拒；副本与 src/ 逐字节一致。验证：新增 cli 与 skill-bundle 测试，现有 49 项测试、插件校验、mod 测试与 tsc 全部通过。范围外：setup 安装命令、outputSchema、ACP 与 Antigravity。

en.reason: Review candidate skill-cli: any planner that can run a shell can use the relay after installing the skill, with no MCP setup. Tool surface: the CLI gains agents, dispatch, wait, result, apply, discard and cancel, and status --json prints the relay_status shape, all through createRelay().call(); createRelay gains maxWaitSeconds (50 s for MCP as before, up to 3600 s for the CLI). Routing skill: skills/agenthub-relay/scripts/ holds a generated copy of src/, SKILL.md leads with the script and keeps MCP optional, and two explicit-only entries relay-review and relay-status are added. Expected: dispatch, wait, result and apply through the CLI give the same records as through MCP; an executor calling CLI dispatch is refused; the copy matches src/ byte for byte. Verification: new cli and skill-bundle tests, and the existing 49 tests, plugin validation, mod tests and tsc all pass. Out of scope: the setup installer, outputSchema, ACP and Antigravity.

reason: 修订计划，范围从 2 个模块扩大到 4 个：用户提出 skill 无法设置执行者模型、也无法在使用中决定谁规划谁执行，因此加入派发策略（src/config.mjs、src/policy.mjs）与执行者适配器（src/executors.mjs）。新增行为：识别规划者身份（--planner、AGENTHUB_RELAY_PLANNER 或 MCP 客户端名），按 plannerProfiles 选 profile（内置 codex→codex-planner）；档位映射与单个任务可指定 model 与 effort，codex 用 -m 与 -c model_reasoning_effort，claude 用 --model 与 --effort，dsh 没有文档化的模型参数，指定时以 model-unsupported 失败；新增 config show/set/unset 与用户级配置；新增只能显式调用的 relay-config。原有内容不变：CLI 补全命令、skill 自带 src/ 的生成副本、relay-review 与 relay-status。验证：新增 config、cli、skill-bundle 测试并扩充 executors、mcp 测试；执行者角色调用 dispatch 与 config set 被拒；现有 49 项测试、插件校验、mod 测试与 tsc 全部通过。

en.reason: Revised plan, scope grows from 2 to 4 modules: the user pointed out that the skill cannot choose an executor's model or decide during use who plans and who executes, so the dispatch policy (src/config.mjs, src/policy.mjs) and the executor adapters (src/executors.mjs) join. New behavior: the planner's identity (--planner, AGENTHUB_RELAY_PLANNER or the MCP client name) selects a profile through plannerProfiles (built in: codex→codex-planner); tier mappings and single jobs can set model and effort (codex: -m and -c model_reasoning_effort; claude: --model and --effort; dsh has no documented model flag and fails with model-unsupported); config show/set/unset and a user-level config file are added, with an explicit-only relay-config entry. Unchanged from the first plan: the full CLI, the skill's generated copy of src/, relay-review and relay-status. Verification: new config, cli and skill-bundle tests and extended executors and mcp tests; an executor calling dispatch or config set is refused; the existing 49 tests, plugin validation, mod tests and tsc all pass.

reason: 第 1 组：配置层与派发策略。config.mjs 增加规划者身份、plannerProfiles、档位映射对象（executor/model/effort）、执行者的 model/effort 默认值与参数模板、用户级配置文件与 config set/unset；policy.mjs 按优先级解析单个任务的模型与推理强度，不支持时以 model-unsupported/effort-unsupported 失败。

en.reason: Group 1: configuration and dispatch policy. config.mjs gains the planner identity, plannerProfiles, object tier mappings (executor/model/effort), executor model/effort defaults and argument templates, a user-level config file and config set/unset; policy.mjs resolves a job's model and effort by precedence and fails with model-unsupported/effort-unsupported where an executor has no flag for them.
